errors.text: The proposed Mn2O3 nanoprecipitation intervention is absent from the target study and is not supported by either cited source.
The claimed gains of up to 20% in strength and 30% in ductility are invented and unsupported.
The stated strain-rate range of 10^-3 to 10^-1 s^-1 is not the target molecular-dynamics range of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1 and is generally not representative of dynamic loading.
The hypothesis omits the target's crystallographic-orientation intervention and its anisotropic yield-strength result.
The proposed mechanism does not address vacancy-assisted Shockley-partial nucleation, stacking-fault formation, temperature softening, or rate-dependent dislocation density.
The precipitate composition, amount, size distribution, and processing route are not specified sufficiently to define a reproducible intervention.
